$comment: #185: scoring profile sets, read by lib/scoring-profiles.ts. #185 PR-3: the publish path (lib/rankings/publish-active.ts) scores each list with the set activeProfileSet names, and refuses a legacy set; activeProfileSet is the one switch; it names v8.1 (D73). #185: the active set holds no other profile, so no other list is scored or published. v8.0 is frozen: it scored the 2026-11 boards, and v8.1 copies its weights unchanged. Weights are fractions. A set with status legacy is frozen, has the one profile all for every tool, and may declare a total other than 1.00; every other set routes each tool to the profile named after its tools.kind and must declare 1.00. A profile with provisional set awaits the decision it names. #186: publicNote true marks a provisional profile whose list page carries a public note; the active set may hold a provisional profile only when it is productivity with publicNote true.

v7.10.label: v7.10
v7.10.description: Published v7.10 weights, one table for every tool. Weights unchanged since v7.6 (81c6b1d1); v7.10 is the info.technical / info.business fold in engine code (#101, 4e8b329a). Sums to 1.02 (#92); kept as-is so D45 can compare against it.

v8.0.label: v8.0
v8.0.description: Published v8.0 profiles (the 2026-11 per-list boards), frozen; superseded by v8.1 (D73), which keeps these weights and drops the company-name bonus in engine code. Routed by tools.kind. harness: technical and adoption each 0.18 -> 0.17, other factors unchanged, sum 1.00. model: its own weights. productivity: the harness weights, provisional, with a public note. No other profile. Kept so its published rows stay explained.

productivity.provisional: D44 harness weights, pending an Architect decision on the productivity profile

v8.1.label: v8.1
v8.1.description: Active v8 profiles, routed by tools.kind; weights and profiles identical to v8.0. v8.1 is the company-name bonus removal in engine code (De4, #313; D73). harness: technical and adoption each 0.17, other factors as v7.10, sum 1.00. model: its own weights, approved for the active set. productivity: the harness weights, provisional, with a public note. No other profile, so a tool of kind other is ranked in no list. Open-weight status is not a factor. Selected by activeProfileSet for the per-list publish.

productivity.provisional: D44 harness weights, pending an Architect decision on the productivity profile
